turns.question: How many customers did we have in September 2026?
turns.answer: "Customers" is ambiguous, so here are all three for 1-30 September 2026: Signups 9 (customers who signed up), Active customers 10 (distinct customers with a non-cancelled order), and Customers to date 30 (everyone signed up by 30 September); tell me which you meant.
